kinds.description: An individual example person, not a class or a personality diagnosis.
A current responsibility or position; one person can hold several.
A past circumstance or experience; not a permanent destiny.
A phase of life, separate from maturity and occupation.
Recurring choices and constraints in daily living.
A tendency, not a guarantee of a particular response.
Something a person considers important; priorities can conflict.
An unmet or fulfilled practical or social requirement.
A diffuse, temporary state; it need not have one target.
A situational response to an appraisal, often with a target.
An enduring attitude toward a person, group, place or memory.
A pattern between people, not a single friendliness score.
A household, peer circle or other collection of people.
An organization with responsibilities, norms and resources.
A traversable or visitable space; separate from its owner.
An object with ownership, custody, uses and restrictions.
Something an actor can attempt; success is not implied.
A conversational act; wording is separate from its intent.
Reusable circumstances with several possible responses.
An occurrence with participants and time; examples are not canon.
A holder-specific recollection of an event, not the event itself.
A proposition someone may hold; not a world fact by default.
A circulating claim with a source chain, not verified information.
An intended outcome, possibly in conflict with another goal.
A duty or commitment involving an actor and beneficiary.
A context-specific expectation; separate from moral truth.
A possible practical, social or institutional aftermath.
A recurring sequence with interruptions and alternatives.
A named interval or recurring schedule boundary.
An environmental condition, not an emotional prescription.
An opportunity made possible by a space or object.
Learned ability, separate from permission and access.
A consumable, scarce means or budget.
An accommodation or assistance; never a personality class.
An audience-specific impression, which can be wrong.
Information with controlled or unequal distribution.
A particular commitment, with beneficiary and fulfillment.
An author-facing theme, not a reward or required ending.
Enrollment, year/grade or completion status; independent of reputation and support needs.

relations.label: is a kind of
relations.description: Same-kind taxonomy only; no inheritance of feelings or history.

relations.label: contains
relations.description: Spatial or organizational containment; cycles rejected.

relations.label: is located in
relations.description: Location is not ownership or permission.

relations.label: connects to
relations.description: A possible route; travel cost/access still need a runtime resolver.

relations.label: serves
relations.description: A service audience, not a stereotype.

relations.label: is a member of
relations.description: Membership can be time-bounded.

relations.label: currently holds
relations.description: A role assignment, not a personality.

relations.label: formerly held
relations.description: Historical assignment; does not grant current authority.

relations.label: has background
relations.description: Past circumstances do not determine present behavior.

relations.label: is at life stage
relations.description: Age/life context independent of roles.

relations.label: has lifestyle
relations.description: A recurring pattern that can change.

relations.label: tends toward
relations.description: A contextual tendency rather than a deterministic action.

relations.label: values
relations.description: A person can value conflicting things.

relations.label: needs
relations.description: Current need state belongs to this person.

relations.label: is in a mood of
relations.description: Temporary diffuse state; no universal duration.

relations.label: experiences
relations.description: A situational emotional response.

relations.label: feels toward
relations.description: Use qualifiers.feeling to identify the feeling node and holder=source.

relations.label: has a relationship with
relations.description: Use qualifiers.relationship_type; direction and reciprocity are explicit.

relations.label: is a parent of
relations.description: Family link; does not imply custody, warmth or co-residence.

relations.label: is a guardian of
relations.description: Care responsibility separate from biological relation.

relations.label: is a sibling of
relations.description: Symmetric family link, not shared feelings.

relations.label: is friends with
relations.description: Authored reciprocal friendship; trust still has direction.

relations.label: mentors
relations.description: An ongoing guidance relationship; time and context matter.

relations.label: supervises
relations.description: Authority is context-bound; never universal.

relations.label: works at
relations.description: Workplace affiliation, not unrestricted access.

relations.label: attends
relations.description: Participation with schedule/context qualifiers.

relations.label: lives at
relations.description: Residence is separate from ownership.

relations.label: owns
relations.description: Ownership separate from current possession.

relations.label: currently carries
relations.description: Possession does not prove ownership or theft.

relations.label: borrowed from
relations.description: qualifiers.object identifies the loaned object.

relations.label: can attempt
relations.description: Capability/opportunity, not an executable behavior tree.

relations.label: is expected to
relations.description: Contextual expectations, not compulsory outcomes.

relations.label: can access
relations.description: Permission can depend on time, purpose and supervision.

relations.label: requires
relations.description: Prerequisite description, not executable code.

relations.label: offers opportunity for
relations.description: Opportunity is not automatic participation.

relations.label: uses
relations.description: An action resource or setting; not always consumed.

relations.label: can happen at
relations.description: A plausible setting, not mandatory staging.

relations.label: includes
relations.description: An authored component; no forced player response.

relations.label: is scheduled during
relations.description: Named time windows; exact clock binding is deferred.

relations.label: precedes
relations.description: Order alone does not mean causation.

relations.label: can interrupt
relations.description: May require rescheduling or an alternative, not cancellation every time.

relations.label: is an alternative to
relations.description: Alternative approach, not identical outcome.

relations.label: may motivate
relations.description: A design hypothesis about a possible choice, not a personality law.

relations.label: may discourage
relations.description: Context-sensitive influence, never a hard ban.

relations.label: can conflict with
relations.description: A tension to resolve in context, not an inevitable conflict.

relations.label: pursues
relations.description: A current intention; success and priority separate.

relations.label: owes a duty of
relations.description: Duty needs beneficiary, context and timing.

relations.label: may fulfill
relations.description: One possible route to an outcome.

relations.label: may undermine
relations.description: A possible tradeoff or harm, not a universal result.

relations.label: is governed by
relations.description: A local rule; enforcement may differ from the written expectation.

relations.label: permits
relations.description: Context-dependent permission.

relations.label: forbids
relations.description: Institutional prohibition, not a global evil tag.

relations.label: can be enforced by
relations.description: A role with authority in the specified context.

relations.label: can lead to
relations.description: An authored possibility; probability/conditions need separate design.

relations.label: can be answered with
relations.description: Available response, not a forced branch.

relations.label: can evoke
relations.description: An optional appraisal, not a universal emotional consequence.

relations.label: can shift toward
relations.description: Context-sensitive change, not permanent character conversion.

relations.label: can support
relations.description: Practical help does not impose gratitude or dependence.

relations.label: may be requested by
relations.description: Individual assistance rather than a segregated character class.

relations.label: can benefit from
relations.description: An accessibility option; no invented diagnostic inference.

relations.label: is perceived as
relations.description: Always observer-held; never an omniscient character identity.

relations.label: believes something about
relations.description: Claim text and source evidence are qualifiers; holder=source.

relations.label: holds belief
relations.description: A proposition with confidence, not truth.

relations.label: is about
relations.description: The subject matter does not establish truth.

relations.label: remembers
relations.description: Private recollection with provenance and fallibility.

relations.label: recalls event
relations.description: An account of the event, not its authoritative copy.

relations.label: witnessed part of
relations.description: Use notes for what was actually observable.

relations.label: heard from
relations.description: Use qualifiers.claim for the belief/rumor ID.

relations.label: knows secret
relations.description: A specific knowledge holder; not automatically shareable.

relations.label: contradicts
relations.description: Conflicting accounts; neither is auto-deleted or adjudicated.

relations.label: is evidence for
relations.description: Evidence affects confidence but is not instant proof.

relations.label: participated in
relations.description: Participant, role and time are explicit.

relations.label: was affected by
relations.description: Impact is distinct from witnessing.

relations.label: made promise
relations.description: Promise is a separate record; can be fulfilled or broken.

relations.label: was promised to
relations.description: Beneficiary separate from witness.

relations.label: requires discretion about
relations.description: Audience-sensitive sharing opportunity.

relations.label: is thematically associated with
relations.description: Author-facing association only; never a simulation trigger.

relations.label: may change access to
relations.description: Institutional consequence can alter opportunity.

relations.label: may revise
relations.description: New evidence may revise an account; no guaranteed forgiveness.

relations.label: may repair
relations.description: Repair is possible, not automatic absolution.

relations.label: may conceal
relations.description: A concealment attempt, not guaranteed invisibility.

relations.label: may reveal
relations.description: Only known information may be disclosed in a future resolver.

relations.label: needs a participant such as
relations.description: Casting slot for a situation, not a specific destined character.

relations.label: is an example of
relations.description: Fixture-to-definition connection, not taxonomy inheritance.

relations.label: may remind someone of
relations.description: Requires a relevant holder; not all visitors share the memory.

relations.label: controls resource
relations.description: Control differs from ownership and permanent possession.

relations.label: may limit
relations.description: A practical constraint; alternatives may exist.

relations.label: can cooperate with
relations.description: Opportunity for collaboration, not guaranteed agreement.

relations.label: can provide
relations.description: Service or resource availability can vary.

relations.label: has education status
relations.description: Enrollment/grade/completion is separate from personality and support.

relations.label: can occur at life stage
relations.description: Illustrative life context, not a rigid eligibility rule.

relations.label: is available in
relations.description: Availability, not compulsory use or a segregated character category.

relations.label: applies to
relations.description: Scope of an expectation, not a moral classification.

relations.label: records prior status
relations.description: A historical status does not assert the person still holds it.

relations.label: can draw on skill
relations.description: Useful ability without making it an eligibility gate.

relations.label: can reframe
relations.description: A possible change of significance, not deterministic psychology.
